description: Describe the df_<id> dataframes staged by ilostat_query_indicator and ilostat_compare_geographies or stored by ilostat_dataframe_query register_as: the tool and parameters that produced each, the datasets it holds (label, unit, last update), coverage, basis counts, attribution, creation and expiry times, row count, and column schema. Pass name for one dataframe. Without it, every staged dataframe is listed, except on a deployment whose callers share one canvas, where listing is off and only the exact name works. Read the schema here before writing SQL for ilostat_dataframe_query.

name.description: One dataframe name as the producing tool returned it (df_XXXXX_XXXXX: letters and digits, five in each part; case-insensitive, as in SQL). Omit to list every staged dataframe; a deployment whose callers share one canvas refuses the listing and needs the name.

name: ilostat_dataframe_describe

dataframes.description: Staged dataframes, newest first; empty when none.

attribution.description: Citation to keep with any use of the data.

basis_counts.description: Rows per basis; absent for a dataframe derived by SQL.

modelled_estimate.description: ILO modelled estimates up to the cutoff.

projection.description: ILO modelled values after the cutoff.

reported.description: Values from a national or institutional source.

coverage.description: Areas and periods covered; absent for a dataframe derived by SQL.

last_update.description: Last upstream update of the dataset.

name.description: Dataframe name, the table to use in SQL.

query_params.description: How the dataframe was produced: the producing tool's applied_filters, or {sql, derived_from} for a dataframe stored by ilostat_dataframe_query register_as.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_unavailable`: The DataCanvas DuckDB engine cannot load in this deployment. `listing_unavailable`: name is omitted where every caller shares one canvas (HTTP with auth none). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the named dataframe does not exist.

title: Describe staged ILOSTAT dataframes
